answer_1.quote: We choose two representative tasks: search engine optimization (SEO) Writer (W ) and Image Prompt Generator (G).
datasets: 44 trending topics and 34 in-house prompts for SEO
answer_1.outputs: Generated web pages and optimized image prompts

answer_2.quote: For the SEO Writer task, we use an API called SEO Review Tools (SEO) to measure the quality of generated content. ... For the Image Generator task ... we calculate the alignment between the prompt and the image and use the alignment score as the evaluation metric. ... we use OpenAI's Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) model ...
